verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payments platform, so background automation is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows no first-party automation builder or autonomous background workflow feature. Webhooks only notify the platform of events, Zapier is a third-party tool users would connect themselves, and configurable deposit frequency is a payout setting rather than a user-defined automation, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
